_note: Coin shop layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255, except splash_colors, [r, g, b] from 0 to 1 (SetColor). Opacities and shades 0 to 1, angles in degrees (counter-clockwise). The page's own positions (page, hero, grid, coupon, note) are in page pixels, 0..page.w and 0..page.h of the Page.png content; a listing's pieces are offsets from its centre, in its own turned frame.

desk._note: Desk.png's top-left (its wood starts 4 px in).

nameplate._note: The player's nameplate on the desk's front.

till._note: The coin counter on the desk's front, centred at (x, y): the coin coin_dx from it, fitted to a coin_size square; the amount right-aligned at amount_dx.

title_plate_offset._note: A nameplate title is drawn this far from the point it is shown at.

confirm._note: The modals sit over the page, leaving the keeper in view: centred on center_x, panel_w wide, the buttons button_w x button_h under each other.

buy._note: The buy dialog; the _quantity values are used when the item has a quantity chooser. Cancel sits button_gap under Buy. The item's picture is fitted to a preview_size square centred at preview_y.

theme._note: The PopUI theme of the modals, in the magazine's paper and ink (PopUI's own key names).

page._note: The catalog page (Page.png, w x h) centred at (x, y); its shadow shadow_dx / shadow_dy further. The masthead is left-aligned at (masthead.x, masthead.y), the issue line right-aligned at issue.x on the same line.

text._note: A text longer than its max width first shrinks, down to fit_min of its size, then squeezes; box_pad (times the scale) is added to the squeeze width.

amount._note: A coin and an amount next to it: the coin coin_w wide (drawn at coin_scale), then gap.

sold._note: A sold-out item's picture or plate: drawn at opacity, its picture shaded to shade.

lift_shadow._note: The soft shadow under a lifted piece, offset by (x, y); EntryShadow.png is tex_w x tex_h and is stretched to the piece; opacity at full selection.

tilt._note: Each listing's rest pose, picked at random in [min, max] when the page is laid out: its tilt by kind, its offset (offset_px each way), the tilt of its tape, price tag and splash.

sticker._note: The price sticker: the coin at coin_y, the price at price_y, fitted to price_max_width.

burst._note: The 'Featured!' burst on the featured listing.

grid._note: The catalog entries' centres (cols x rows, row by row) and size: with_featured beside the featured listing, full without it.

cell._note: A catalog entry. A nameplate title sits at plate_y as a cut-out, its shadow plate_shadow, its tape at plate_tape_y; another item's photo at photo_y, its shadow photo_shadow, its picture fitted to picture, its tape at tape_y. The name is name_inset narrower than the entry.

keeper._note: The keeper's feet (bottom centre, behind the desk's front).

bubble._note: The speech bubble's tail tip at (tip_x, tip_y); the image centre sits at tip + (dx, dy), its body centre body_dy above that (all times the bubble's scale). The text wraps at text_w; text_pad moves each line left.
